rationale: The analysis correctly identifies the downstream rate-limit reduction as the trigger, retries with exponential backoff as the latency mechanism, and the cache-bypass header as the mediator of the cache hit-rate decline, explicitly ruling out cache degradation as an independent cause (using E3 and E6 as disconfirming evidence, matching the forbidden-claim boundary correctly). All four required findings are present, and no forbidden claim is made. Causal structure (contributes-to, mediates, precedes, prevents) accurately reflects the evidence without invented mechanisms. Every claim is evidence-mapped with no outside-evidence use. Uncertainty is appropriately scoped to genuinely unresolved details (reason for rate-limit cut, quantification, two-minute delay) while maintaining justified high confidence on the well-supported causal chain, consistent with the case's low-uncertainty ground truth. Actions are correctly prioritized on the rate-limit/retry mechanism first, with the cache-bypass header change appropriately deprioritized and framed as not addressing the primary mechanism, avoiding any weakening of protective controls.
